material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Jul 29 low, the average price paid since the Nov 3 high and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 23–Nov 3 rise, where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the March high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Weekly: a deep wave 4
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Sep 17, 2025 to May 6 (+111%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback is under the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+9.8% to +2.2%), with the 50-week average and the Jun 8 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−19%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: Selling is losing force
material.text: A lower low in price (Nov 5) against a higher low in momentum (6 of 7 gauges): regular bullish divergence.
material.learn: Lower price lows with rising momentum lows: sellers are tiring.

standouts.head: Holding its rising 20-day

standouts.head: In a 6-week base
standouts.text: It has moved sideways for 6 weeks in a range 13% deep after a +28% advance.
standouts.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.

against.head: MACD just turned down
against.text: MACD crossed below its signal line on Nov 16, above zero: an early turn.
against.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 35% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

material.head: Uptrend on every average
material.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.
material.learn: Both averages rising with price over them: the long trend points up.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 turning up from its zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Feb 12 to Aug 20 (+63%; wave 3 is 1.6 times wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−8% to −13%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Oct 23, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−11%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.
